title: ProjectMcpServer
description: One server a project's own MCP file declares, with where it stands with this user (plan 13, B-24). Unlike a server of the store, `env` and `headers` carry their value literal — a project file is plain text already in the repository, never a secret of ours (D-11).

folderPath.description: The folder whose own MCP file declares this entry — not necessarily the folder a session opens in; an ancestor of it.

state.description: pending: never decided. approved: our decision matches the entry's current digest. rejected: our decision, holding regardless of the digest. changed: approved once, at a digest the entry no longer has.

digest.description: The entry's current digest — what a PUT of the approval route must carry back.

approvedSnapshot.description: What was approved, for `state` `approved` or `changed` — `null` for `pending`/`rejected`, and for a decision recorded before this field existed (plan 13, B-28, D-80). The screen diffs this against the fields above, the current content, for a `changed` entry.
